concept: Atlas Admin API rate limiting for scheduled polling

claims.text: Schedule periodic polling with a stable per-worker offset to spread synchronized cron bursts, and cap retries at one layer; Amazon documents both practices from operational experience. (low confidence)
After HTTP 429, honor Retry-After when present and apply exponential backoff with jitter; another client can exhaust the shared bucket before the retry. (medium confidence)

Use GET /api/atlas/v2/rateLimits with scope filters to inspect applicable policies; atlas api rateLimiting exposes listRateLimits and getRateLimit commands. Defaults can change without notice or differ after support adjustments. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)
Atlas V2 uses token buckets shared by endpoint set and resource scope; one uniform project-wide request limit does not describe the API. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

RateLimit-Limit describes burst capacity, RateLimit-Remaining available tokens, and Retry-After a minimum delay in seconds after throttling; clients must tolerate absent headers. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Microsoft’s Atlas discovery integration distinguishes temporary rate-limit failures from authentication and permission failures, and lets users retry one credential without rechecking every credential. (low confidence)

MongoDB’s Terraform provider documents OAuth token acquisition returning 429 independently of resource calls; its troubleshooting guidance scopes this limit to the IP-address and Service Account client combination. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)

Documented GROUP defaults are capacity 1200 and refill 500/60 seconds for Performance Advisor, including slowQueryLogs, versus capacity 300 and refill 100/60 seconds for Monitoring And Logs. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14)

Mattering’s own Atlas integration reports HTTP 429 instead of silently retrying; its documentation recommends wait steps between bursts and spreading scheduled sweeps apart. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30)
Scheduling inference: budget aggregate poll requests, pagination and retries per endpoint set and project against refill rate; burst capacity is not sustained throughput. (medium confidence)
